description: Operator corrections for paper-institution links and institution attributes. Applied by pipeline/lib/institution_policy.py on every bibliography build. relink: move matching links to the 'to' institution (ROR id preferred). drop: delete matching links. set: overwrite attributes of matching institutions. A match combines ror_id, institution (stored name), raw_contains (source string, case-insensitive) and paper (slug prefix); every given field must hold.
